tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read part or all of a text file and return each selected line prefixed with its 1-based line number. By default, reads from the beginning of the file through the end.

filepath.description: Path to the file to read.

start_line.description: 1-based first line to return. Values below 1 are treated as 1.

end_line.description: 1-based last line to return, inclusive. Defaults to the end of the file.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace the first occurrence of an exact string in a file with another string. Fails if the provided string is not found in the file.

filepath.description: Path to the file to modify.

old_str.description: Exact text to search for in the file.

new_str.description: Text that replaces every occurrence of old_str.

tools.name: list_files
tools.description: List the entries directly inside a directory. Optionally filter entries by requiring the pattern to appear in their filename. Each entry is identified as a directory, symbolic link, or regular file.

directory.description: Path to the directory to inspect.

pattern.description: Optional substring that must be present in the entry name.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search the repository recursively for an exact text pattern and return the matching file paths and line locations. Optionally restrict the search to paths containing a given file pattern.

file_pattern.description: Optional substring that must be present in the file path for the file to be searched.

tools.name: search_function_or_class_definition_in_code
tools.description: Search the repository recursively for function and class definitions whose declared name exactly matches the given name. Returns the file path and line containing each match.

name.description: Exact function or class name to look for.

tools.name: find_references
tools.description: Find usages of a function or class. For Python files, uses Jedi for symbol-aware reference resolution; for ther supported source files, searches parsed symbol data. A filepath and optional line can be supplied to identify the specific definition to analyze.

name.description: Name of the function or class whose usages should be found.

filepath.description: Optional source file containing the definition. Required when line is specified.

line.description: Optional 1-based line containing the definition to analyze. Requires filepath.

tools.name: run_tests
tools.description: Run the repository's evaluation test script and return its standard output. Uses TESTBED_PATH when it is defined; otherwise runs from the current working directory.

tools.name: get_patch
tools.description: Return the unified Git diff between the current working tree and HEAD, showing all uncommitted changes in the repository. Uses TESTBED_PATH when it is defined; otherwise runs from the current working directory.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Execute a command in a specified working directory and return its standard output. The command is parsed into arguments and is not executed through a shell.

command.description: Command line to execute, including its arguments.

workdir.description: Optional working directory in which to execute the command.
